landing.title: From zero to hero, one milestone at a time
landing.lede: For a certification, a new language or a career shift. Use it alone or with friends.

create.title: Create a trail
create.body: Give it a name, a goal and, if you like, a date. Start from scratch or copy someone's template.

split.title: Break it into milestones
split.body: Group milestones into phases. Each milestone is something you can finish.

tick.title: Tick them off
tick.body: Attach evidence when you finish: a link, a note or the certificate.

share.title: Share
share.body: Publish your trail as a template, follow friends and cheer them on.

login.title: Sign in
login.demoBody: Explore with sample trails and friends. Everything stays in this browser.
login.errorGeneric: Could not sign in. Check your details and try again.

home.greeting: Hi, {name}. Ready to tick another one?
home.weekStrip: {count} milestone completed in the last 7 days | {count} milestones completed in the last 7 days
home.weekStripEmpty: No milestones in the last 7 days. The next one is waiting.
home.newTrackHint: from scratch or from a template
home.empty: No trails yet. Create your first one, or copy a template from Explore.

track.deleteConfirm: Delete this trail and all its progress?
track.noFollowers: Nobody yet. Make it public to be found.
track.noEvidence: Evidence you attach shows up here.
track.notFound: This trail does not exist or is not shared with you.
track.forecast: At this pace you finish around {date}.
track.forecastLate: At this pace you finish around {date}, after your target.
track.loadError: Could not load this trail. Try again.
track.reopenBody: Its evidence and time spent will be deleted.
track.actionError: That did not work. Try again.

complete.title: Complete milestone
complete.file: File (PDF or image, up to 10 MB)
complete.fileDemo: In the demo only the file name is kept.
complete.celebrateLeft: {count} left to finish the trail. | {count} left to finish the trail.
complete.celebrateDone: That was the last one. The whole trail is done!
complete.errorUrl: Add a link that starts with http:// or https://.
complete.errorFile: Pick a PDF or image up to 10 MB.
complete.errorMinutes: Time spent is a whole number of minutes.

editor.name: Name

start.pasteHint: Markdown or plain text, one per line

pasteError.invalid_color: Line {line}: "{value}" is not a color we know (use violet, coral, sky, mint or sun).
pasteError.invalid_visibility: Line {line}: "{value}" is not a visibility option.
pasteError.invalid_date: Line {line}: "{value}" is not a valid date (use YYYY-MM-DD).
pasteError.future_date: Line {line}: {value} is in the future, so today's date was used.
pasteError.too_many_phases: Line {line}: only 20 phases fit; the rest was skipped.
pasteError.too_many_milestones: Line {line}: only 200 milestones fit; the rest was skipped.

editor.templateMissing: That template isn't available anymore. Pick another one or start blank.
editor.errorSave: Could not save the trail. Try again.
editor.removeDoneBody: "{title}" is done. Saving will delete its completion and evidence.
editor.errorPhaseEmpty: Each phase needs at least one milestone.
editor.pasteHint: One item per line. # names the trail, > adds the goal, ## starts a phase, - [x] marks a milestone as done. Add #tag and {'@'}YYYY-MM-DD after the title. An optional line like emoji: 🦀 {'|'} color: coral {'|'} visibility: public sets the look.

explore.title: Explore trails
explore.usedBy: used by {count} person | used by {count} people
explore.empty: Nothing here yet. Try another search.
explore.emptyFriends: None of your friends has shared a trail yet.

friends.title: Friends
friends.feedEmpty: Nothing yet. Add friends to see their progress.
friends.listEmpty: No friends yet. Search by name or {'@'}handle above to add one.

profile.notFound: No one here with that handle.
profile.weekTitle: {count} milestone that week | {count} milestones that week

welcome.title: Welcome! Pick your handle
welcome.lede: Friends find you by it. You can change it later.
welcome.name: Display name

settings.title: Settings
settings.demoBody: Put the sample trails back the way they started.
settings.demoResetBody: Everything you changed in the demo will be lost.

error.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

meta.description: Build a study trail, break it into milestones and tick them off one by one.
meta.ogDescription: Study trails with milestones, evidence and friends.
